data.name: Sample - Xiting Falcora - 1.0.0
data.description: Falcora is Xiting's security operations platform for SAP landscapes. It triages SAP security alerts with AI against customer SOPs, groups them into cases, collects system owner feedback and supports the analyst up to the final verdict. This connector ingests Falcora alerts into FortiSOAR and performs actions like reading alerts and cases, adding enrichment comments, assigning case processors and re-running the AI case analysis.

workflows.name: Get Alerts
workflows.description: Retrieves a list of alerts from Falcora, newest first, based on the time range and filters you have specified. The time range applies to the time Falcora received the alert. Falcora does not page this list, so keep time ranges short.

workflows.name: Get Alert Details
workflows.description: Retrieves the full details of a specific alert, including the raw event, triage justification, SOP, owner feedback and action log, based on the alert ID you have specified.

workflows.name: Get Cases
workflows.description: Retrieves a list of cases from Falcora based on the time range and filters you have specified. The time range applies to the case creation time.

workflows.name: Get Case Details
workflows.description: Retrieves the full details of a specific case, including the summary, AI analysis, analyst decision, progress, latest AI investigation, history and comments, based on the case ID you have specified.

workflows.name: Get Case Alerts
workflows.description: Retrieves the alerts linked to a specific case.

workflows.name: Add Case Comment
workflows.description: Adds enrichment to a case as a plain-text comment. Comments longer than 1000 characters are split into several comments. The sequence "${" is escaped automatically. Comments cannot be deleted and completed cases do not accept comments.

workflows.name: Assign Case Processor
workflows.description: Sets or clears the processor of a case. Only the processor can finalize a case.

workflows.name: Trigger Case Analysis
workflows.description: Re-runs the AI case analysis, for example after adding significant enrichment. Also reopens completed cases for analysis.

workflows.name: > Xiting Falcora > Fetch
workflows.description: Fetches alerts received by Xiting Falcora since the last pull. The window ends a configurable delay before now, so most alerts have finished AI triage when they are fetched.

step_variables._configuration_schema:
[
  {
    "title": "Pull Alerts Received in Past X Minutes",
    "name": "minutes",
    "type": "integer",
    "visible": true,
    "required": false,
    "editable": true,
    "value": 60,
    "tooltip": "On the first run, pull the alerts received in the past X minutes.",
    "description": "On the first run, pull the alerts received in the past X minutes. Later runs continue from the last pull time."
  },
  {
    "title": "Triage Delay (Minutes)",
    "name": "delayMinutes",
    "type": "integer",
    "visible": true,
    "required": false,
    "editable": true,
    "value": 5,
    "tooltip": "Only pull alerts received at least this many minutes ago.",
    "description": "Only pull alerts received at least this many minutes ago, so Falcora has time to finish AI triage. Set to 0 to pull immediately."
  },
  {
    "title": "Overlap (Minutes)",
    "name": "overlapMinutes",
    "type": "integer",
    "visible": true,
    "required": false,
    "editable": true,
    "value": 1,
    "tooltip": "Overlap consecutive pull windows by this many minutes.",
    "description": "Overlap consecutive pull windows by this many minutes. Alerts fetched twice are upserted on the Falcora alert ID (Source ID). Set to 0 if the unique constraint of the Alerts module (Source ID by default) was changed."
  },
  {
    "title": "Include Alert Details",
    "name": "includeDetails",
    "type": "checkbox",
    "visible": true,
    "required": false,
    "editable": true,
    "value": true,
    "tooltip": "Read each alert individually to include the raw event and triage justification.",
    "description": "Read each alert individually to include the raw event (AlertData), triage justification, SOP and owner feedback. Makes one extra request per alert."
  }
]

arguments.windowStart: {%- if vars.lastPullTime and vars.lastPullTime | string != '0' -%}{{ arrow.get(vars.lastPullTime).shift(minutes=-(vars.overlapMinutes | int)).format('YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss') }}Z{%- else -%}{{ arrow.utcnow().shift(minutes=-((vars.minutes | int) + (vars.delayMinutes | int))).format('YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss') }}Z{%- endif -%}

workflows.description: Ingests alerts from Xiting Falcora into FortiSOAR alerts.

workflows.name: Xiting Falcora > Sync Alerts
workflows.description: Keeps ingested Xiting Falcora alerts in sync with Falcora. Re-reads the open FortiSOAR alerts from Falcora created in the last maxAgeDays days (newest first, at most batchSize per run) and updates the ones whose triage, owner feedback, case or processing status changed. Run it on a schedule.

workflows.name: > Xiting Falcora > Update Record
workflows.description: Updates one FortiSOAR alert with the latest data from Xiting Falcora: description, source data and, unless an analyst changed it, severity. Adds a comment listing what changed. Called by Xiting Falcora > Sync Alerts.
